summary: 23/31 requirements PASS. The single biggest gap is format inconsistency in 4/11 modules (infrastructure, qps-bench-server, scrapy-__main__, scrapy-scraper): these modules use ### section headers instead of the required #### and 3 of them lack <!-- file:xxx --> markers entirely. This causes Appendix G to report only 74/126 = 59% complete file blocks — the automated checker cannot detect sections in the wrong format. The 7 correctly formatted modules (cli, conf, qpsclient, scrapy-bench, scrapydocs, testing-conftest, testing-conftest-1) all pass every applicable check, demonstrating the Skill works correctly when followed. The Skill instructions are clear (⚠️ MANDATORY FORMAT warnings exist), so the root cause is primarily agent_error — sub-agents writing these 4 modules ignored the template. The fix is to make the post-write validation a blocking gate: sub-agents must assert marker/section-count equality before calling submit_analysis, making non-compliant output self-correcting rather than silently accepted.
